item.title: Stellwerk 0.27.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #110 `490b860` Thanks @GarreltMock! - "New project…" next to "Open project…" and "Clone from GitHub…" (Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android): a name and a parent folder on the Mac (default ~/stellwerk/repos), and Stellwerk makes the folder with git and a first commit, optionally a private GitHub repository with gh, and adds it as a project.
  • #100 `f1abce9` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Several run scripts per repository (`[scripts.run.<name>]` with `command`, a lucide `icon` and `default`, as Conductor has them): the Mac's Run tab lists them, each with Run, Stop once it has been up a second, and Open once it printed a local address, plus its own terminal; each runs on its own port. Settings → project → Run scripts edits them with an icon picker. iPhone, iPad and Android show the running and failed ones over the chat and all of them under "…" → Run scripts. While a run script runs, the workspace's time in the workspace lists is in Conductor's activity blue, on every app, and the Mac's Run tab has a blue dot. `run_mode` is gone: run scripts always run side by side.
  • #101 `d86c7cf` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Team host: one Mac shared by a small team. Choose "Team host" in the setup or Settings → Devices; each person pairs and signs in with GitHub (and Claude) on their phone or Mac. Messages show who wrote them, chats and workspaces who takes part, the message box who is typing. A turn runs on the Claude login, git author, GitHub token and gcloud config of the person who wrote it, with the chat's other people as co-authors; new branches carry their prefix, notifications go only to people in the chat. The Tailscale Serve port is a setting, so several macOS users can each run a host on one Mac. iOS, Android and the Mac window alike. A signed-in Mac pairs further phones as the same person (Settings → Account → Pair a phone), and the host reads GitHub with its people's sign-ins, so a bot account is optional.

    • Patch Changes

  • #95 `06a63ea` Thanks @grischaerbe! - A workspace's setup script runs before its agent starts: the first prompt (and anything sent meanwhile, also after unarchiving) waits in the chat's queue until setup is done, failed or stopped, so the agent no longer runs setup steps of its own alongside it.
  • #92 `bad510f` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac dashboards: back at the top of the sidebar under Search, with the page's favicon (the picked icon when it has none) and their ⌘⌥ shortcut at the row's end.
  • #104 `37ebf0e` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Diffs: a long line scrolls sideways instead of being cut off on the Mac or wrapped on iPhone and iPad, as on Android.
  • #102 `8e895ab` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Fable 5.2 in the model picker, right after Opus 5.5; Fable 5.1 stays further down for chats that use it.
  • #112 `614a24e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - The Mac host closes each git call's pipes as soon as git is done instead of a minute or two later: with many workspaces and terminals it held thousands of files open and ran into "Too many open files", and phones and the window couldn't reach it.
  • #96 `87d10e5` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Mac: a `stellwerk://` link, from a dashboard or elsewhere, no longer sends Stellwerk to the background while the window is open.
  • #108 `e617c67` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the sidebar, the right panel and the Setup / Run logs have no fixed maximum anymore; they grow as far as the chat keeps its minimum width (and the panel's top its minimum height), as in Conductor.
  • #106 `be76e17` Thanks @GarreltMock! - When Claude only wakes up for a line from a Monitor, its end no longer sends a "finished" notification for every line.
  • #97 `41c648c` Thanks @GarreltMock! - iPhone notifications: "Only for messages from the phone" works again. Messages typed in a Mac's Stellwerk window no longer count as the phone's, and the Operator's work counts only when the phone asked for it.
  • #112 `614a24e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - The Mac host raises its open-file limit at launch, so big projects no longer fail with "Too many open files".
  • #112 `614a24e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - The host log names its open files and the limit at start, and notes when they pass half or most of the limit (and when they're back down), so a leak shows before "Too many open files".
  • #107 `2ccdc8b` Thanks @GarreltMock! - PR badge shows the pull request of the branch checked out now: when an agent switches to a new branch, the workspace follows it instead of keeping its first branch's PR.
  • #94 `8d5a637` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Mac: pressing the PR button (Create PR, Merge, …) shows a spinner in the icon's color and size in its place; the icon no longer just vanishes for a moment on the light Create PR button.
  • #109 `a4ff3b6` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the default color theme is called Stellwerk instead of Conductor, and the Run tab, run script settings and "Ask agent" prompts name `$STELLWERK_PORT` / `$STELLWERK_ROOT_PATH` instead of the `CONDUCTOR_*` ones (both are still set). Stellwerk's own types drop the old name (`StellwerkDB`, `StellwerkColor`, `Host/Store`).
  • #99 `f76b7a4` Thanks @grischaerbe! - iPhone and Android: the setup script's row over the chat shows only while the script runs or after it failed, no longer "Completed setup script" for good. On iPhone the row now has a background, so the chat no longer shows through it. The setup log stays in the "…" menu.
  • #103 `f8454c2` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Mac: text pasted after an attachment in the message box (⌘V, or dictated with apps like Wispr Flow that paste) is sent again. Only the attachment reached the agent.

item.title: Stellwerk 0.26.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • #90 `73f4b7f` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac dashboards: per dashboard, "Open links to other sites in the browser" can be switched off so they stay in the dashboard; ⌘-click still opens the browser.
  • #90 `73f4b7f` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac dashboards: a sign-in through another site (Cloudflare Access, Google, Okta …) finishes in the dashboard instead of opening in the browser, so its login sticks.

item.title: Stellwerk 0.26.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #86 `13ba69f` Thanks @GarreltMock! - A PR that still needs a review can be merged from Stellwerk when you may bypass the branch's rules (a ruleset's bypass list): the git bar says "PR review required, you can bypass it" and offers Merge on every app.
  • #74 `86fc31c` Thanks @GarreltMock! - A tap on an image in a chat opens the viewer on all of the chat's images (prompts' attachments and the agent's images, not those of tool calls), not just its message's. On the Mac the viewer shows them all as a strip at the bottom to click through, next to the arrows and the ← → keys; iPhone and Android swipe through them.
  • #75 `0be707f` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Settings → Agents → "Permission mode" → Auto runs agents with their own safety checks instead of skipping permissions. Claude runs in Claude Code's auto mode, and when its classifier blocks something the chat waits for you to allow or deny it (iOS, Android, Mac). Codex runs in its sandbox (the workspace, the repository's .git and the project's extra folders), and its auto reviewer decides approvals, shown as rows in the chat.
  • #81 `20d275e` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Dashboards get the Mac window's color theme: every page has `--stellwerk-*` CSS variables (22 colors and the font, light and dark under `prefers-color-scheme`, which follows Stellwerk's Light / Dark / System), `data-stellwerk-theme` / `data-stellwerk-scheme` on `<html>`, `window.stellwerk.theme` and a `stellwerk:theme` event when the theme changes, live without a reload. Mac only, like the dashboards.
  • #79 `7fac780` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Links like Conductor's: `stellwerk://chat/<chat id>` opens a chat on whichever paired Mac has it, switching to that Mac (a closed one comes back as a tab), `stellwerk://new?repo=…&prompt=…&branch=…` opens New workspace with the message box filled in, without sending. Every chat's menu has **Copy chat link**, and agents learn both links from the Stellwerk skill. On the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android.
  • #81 `20d275e` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Dashboards in the Mac window: Settings → Dashboards takes web pages with a title, URL and icon. Each one is a row in the sidebar above the projects, scrolling with them (in the order dragged into place there, ⌘⌥1–9), and shows the page in place of the chat, with back, forward, reload and "Open in browser"; the 3 most recent pages stay loaded for up to 10 minutes off screen. Links to other sites open in the browser. Mac only for now: the dashboards live in the Mac window's settings, so iPhone, iPad and Android don't show them.
  • #87 `ef4b75d` Thanks @fabifink! - Mac: images in a chat can be saved. Right-click one for **Save to Downloads** (numbered like the Finder's copies when the name is taken, the Dock's Downloads stack bounces), **Save As…** and **Copy Image**, always the original file, not the thumbnail. The image viewer has a Save to Downloads button next to Share (⌘S); "Saved to Downloads" shows for a moment, a click on it shows the file in the Finder. iPhone, iPad and Android already save from their image viewer (Share → Save Image, Save Image).
  • #69 `13f0997` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Pi as a third agent beside Claude Code and Codex, for local models: with Pi on the Mac, every model LM Studio or Ollama on it has shows in the model picker on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android without configuring anything (a bundled Pi extension asks them), e.g. "gemma-4-26b-a4b (LM Studio)", next to Pi's other models (`~/.pi/agent/models.json`, signed-in providers). An LM Studio model that isn't loaded gets loaded before Pi talks to it, with 64K tokens of context (`STELLWERK_LOCAL_CONTEXT`). Pi chats run `pi --mode rpc`, resume from Pi's session file, steer while working, stop, show thinking levels for models that think and answer extension dialogs as questions; branch names come from the chat's model. Enabling Entire in a project also adds Pi's extension; Pi 1.x chats trust the workspace's own `.pi` (`--approve`) so it loads. Not yet in Pi chats: plan mode, going back to a turn, usage limits. Pi chats can use the web through `stellwerk-browser`, a small CLI after Mario Zechner's browser-tools: a private headless Chrome per workspace with a fresh profile (none of your logins) beside your own Chrome, for searching (DuckDuckGo), reading pages, clicking, typing, JavaScript and screenshots, without MCP, API keys or Claude; Pi learns it from a few lines in its system prompt. Its Chrome ends with the chat or after 15 idle minutes, the profile with it. Without Chrome, search and read fall back to plain HTTP. Searches and page reads show like Claude's Web Search and Fetch.
  • #69 `13f0997` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Projects get their own defaults (Settings → the project on the Mac): one of the Mac's presets (Default models; e.g. a local model through Pi) that new workspaces in the project start with on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android instead of the Mac's default; and, with more than one Claude account, the account the project's Claude chats run on, whichever one is active for the rest (switching it moves the project's chats like switching the active account).
  • #77 `e9bcbe2` Thanks @kaptnkoala! - The agent's question works like Conductor's: one question at a time with dots to jump between them, picking the answer of a one-answer question moves on to the next (and from the last, with all answered, sends the answers), "Other…" moves on with return (pasted lines keep their line breaks), chosen options stand out with a check, and an X at the top right stops the agent like the stop button. On the Mac the card takes the keys when it comes, unless there's text in the message box or another field has them (then Tab in the message box hands them over): ↑ ↓ over the options, ↵ or space picks (toggles on multi-select), 1–9 and 0 for "Other…", ← → between questions, ⌘↵ sends, esc goes back to the message box, as does answering or stopping. iPhone and Android get the same card without the keys.
  • #76 `85f2749` Thanks @kaptnkoala! - Scripts can come from `.stellwerk/settings.toml`: Stellwerk reads it first and uses the committed `.conductor/settings.toml` only where a repository has none, so a repository can give Stellwerk its own setup, run and archive scripts while Conductor keeps reading `.conductor/`.

    • Patch Changes

  • #67 `a0bf10a` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: Claude's file tools no longer write outside the workspace or to Claude Code's settings files (Claude Code 2.1.314+). Settings → Agents → "File edits only inside the workspace" turns this off, and a project's "Folders agents may edit" allows more folders. The Usage tab warns from ten days before Claude Code's login ends.
  • #73 `8b0f400` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: when git can't run because the Xcode license isn't agreed to or the Command Line Tools are missing, the setup's Accounts step says so and fixes it, and failed imports and other git errors show git's own message instead of "LoginShell.Failure error 1".
  • #71 `ba51aaf` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the experimental "Listen on all interfaces" switch is gone; the host is reachable only through Tailscale Serve, so the token never crosses the LAN in plain http. The Operator's tools use a token of their own that opens nothing else.
  • #84 `b78e85e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: a chat link to the workspace already open leaves a dashboard, Search or a draft on screen and shows the chat.
  • #78 `5f34cc5` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Codex in auto mode can no longer change the repository's git config or hooks from its sandbox. Android build tools updated.
  • #82 `091152c` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Phones: over the saved copy the notice shows at once ("Connecting… · showing what was there at 10:42"), not only after several failed loads, and says "Offline" sooner (12 s per try instead of 45 s). Below it "Trying again in 8 s" and a Retry button. While the saved copy shows, a workspace's working ring stands still in grey and a chat's working mark turns into a dotted circle, since that agent may be done by now. iOS and Android.
  • #88 `5663aa1` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Mac, Settings → Operator: clearer text under "Pick up new to-dos". It now says the Operator handles small to-dos itself, starts a workspace for bigger ones or asks you first, and that with the switch off new to-dos just stay in the list.
  • #89 `f336096` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Mac: the PR button at the top right of the right panel sits as far from the window's right edge as from its top, so it fits evenly into the window's rounded corner, like in Conductor.
  • #83 `4cba4f9` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: a working workspace in the sidebar shows a ring turning around its glyph in the theme's accent color, like on the phone, instead of the small spinner.
  • #89 `f336096` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Mac: the PR button with a ▾ shows a faint line in the button's icon color between the two halves, also on the light Create PR button where it was missing, and the git icons in it are a bit larger with a stronger line.
  • #80 `4a07a18` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Team sessions: Search and the team list show only sessions from projects added on this Mac, not every repository Entire lets you read

item.title: Stellwerk 0.25.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • #68 `a8bb178` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: smaller download, the disk image is LZMA-compressed (about a third smaller)

    • 0.25.0

    Minor Changes

  • #47 `dd83501` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: an experimental chat minimap (Settings → Experimental, off by default). A narrow overview of the whole chat at the right edge, as in VS Code, with tiny thumbnails of its images, to find and jump to a place: click to jump, drag or scroll to move, hover a thumbnail to see it larger. Mac only; the phones lack the width.
  • #47 `dd83501` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Search in chats: ⌘F (on the phones in the chat's menu) opens a find bar over the chat that marks the messages holding the words, steps through them ("3 of 12") and loads older messages to find more. Search on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android gets Messages: every chat's prompts and replies, archived workspaces' too, from a full-text index on the Mac; a hit opens the chat on that message. Search opens with the cursor in its field on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android.
  • #47 `dd83501` Thanks @GarreltMock! - A token per device: the pairing QR code and link carry a one-time code (10 minutes, works once) that the iPhone, Android or another Mac swaps for its own token. Settings → Devices on the Mac lists the paired phones and Macs with when they were paired and last seen, and revokes one without the others; the phones' Settings show the list too. Phones and Macs paired before keep working and switch to their own token by themselves. "Rotate shared token" ends only the pairings still on the old shared token. Older apps can't read the new pairing links: update them first.
  • #47 `dd83501` Thanks @GarreltMock! - "Fork to new tab", "Fork to new workspace" and "Reset chat" in the "…" under an agent's reply now work, on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android: a new chat (or workspace with the files as the turn left them) holding the chat up to that turn, or the chat itself taken back to it after asking, files included, with what was there kept in a checkpoint. Claude chats only for now; Codex chats keep them greyed out.
  • #50 `b139f5e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: a guided setup on first start, in five steps. This Mac; Agents: Claude Code and Codex installed and signed in from the app (one is enough); Accounts: GitHub (sign in with a device code and the workflow scope, git uses that login, git's name and email from GitHub) and Entire; Phone: QR code, Tailscale and Serve, ticked off once a phone connects; Projects: import from Conductor or add one from GitHub or a folder. Settings → Advanced → Run setup again shows it again. The GitHub CLI now comes with Stellwerk (a gh of your own wins), so agents have gh without Homebrew. Reading Conductor's projects also works when its database can't be opened read-only. On Mac, iPhone and Android the project toggle now reads "Team chats for this project (enables Entire)"; otherwise the phone apps don't change.
  • #62 `c26c33c` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: two Lotum color themes (Settings → Appearance), in Lotum's neon #CFFF00. Ayu Lotum: Ayu Dark with the neon for its yellow. Lotum: white and black with neon fills, light and dark, set in Montserrat. Mac window only, like the other themes; the phones keep their own look.
  • #55 `a61a935` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: changed images open in Changes as before and after (with size), other binary files (PDFs, …) show their content instead of "Binary file". The right panel's tabs open from a "+" menu like t3code's (All files F, Changes C, Checks K; × on a tab closes it), Changes is open by default. New "All files" tab, like Conductor's: the workspace's files as a tree with a filter; a file opens as a tab next to the chats. The host serves files git lists (not ignored ones like `.env`) and a changed file's version at the base (`rev=base`).
  • #58 `e662d0d` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the right panel's bottom has a "+" after Usage for terminals you can close (×), up to three per workspace, instead of a fixed Terminal tab. An empty Setup or Run tab offers "Ask agent" (a new chat with the prompt ready, you add what you want) and "Add manually" (the project's settings).
  • #56 `46c6c70` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: a terminal. Terminals at the right panel's bottom: your shell in the workspace's folder with the scripts' variables. The host runs them, so they keep going when the window closes; archiving a workspace ends them, and asks first (on the Mac, iPhone and Android) while a program like `claude` still runs in one. Mac only, the phones have no terminals.
  • #47 `dd83501` Thanks @GarreltMock! - iPhone, iPad, Android: the app shows the last known workspaces and the 20 chats opened last at once on a cold start, without network or while the Mac sleeps, then loads as usual. If loading fails, a notice says "Offline · showing what was there at 10:42". Not in the Mac window.
  • #47 `dd83501` Thanks @GarreltMock! - New in the Mac's Usage tab: "Continue when limits reset". When Claude's limits stop a turn and no account has room left, the chat carries on by itself a minute after they reset. The chat shows "Resumes at 14:05" with a Cancel button, on the Mac, iPhone and Android.
  • #54 `5e8de0e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: import projects from Superset (Paradev), in the setup's Projects step and Settings → Advanced → Import projects from Superset. Each picked project gets its own clone in ~/stellwerk/repos with the .env files of its folder, like the Conductor import; Superset's workspaces and your folders stay as they are. "Team chats for this project (enables Entire)" now starts unticked everywhere: both imports and Add project on Mac, iPhone and Android; projects that already have Entire keep it. The import itself is Mac only.
  • #47 `dd83501` Thanks @GarreltMock! - A queue you can see and edit: follow-ups sent with queue wait in a tray above the message box, numbered, instead of as faded bubbles in the chat. Send one now (it steers the running turn), edit it in place, remove it or reorder it (Mac: drag handle; iPhone: swipe, "…" or long-press drag; Android: "…" or long-press drag). The queue lives on the Mac, so every app shows the same one, and it survives a restart. After Stop it waits ("Paused · sends after your next message") instead of starting right away. While the agent works, sending now queues by default on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android; Send now (⌘↩, holding the phones' send button, or the button that stays on the message queued last) puts it right into the turn. The Mac's Settings → General can switch back to steering.
  • #47 `dd83501` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Watch pull requests: a switch in Settings → Git on the Mac (off by default). When a workspace's PR has failing checks, new review comments from others or a merge conflict, its most recent chat gets the matching prompt (Fix errors, Address comments, Resolve conflicts) once all its chats are idle; each event once, at most 3 times an hour per workspace.
  • #47 `dd83501` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Work on a PR: "Start from" above a new workspace's first message picks a pull request or a remote branch instead of a fresh branch off the base (open PRs with filters Mine and Drafts, search, checks, Draft, Has workspace; or the remote branches); the workspace is made on that branch with the PR in the git bar, or the workspace already on it opens. On the Mac the project's "+" now opens a draft workspace (a "New workspace" row, × to discard) with the normal message box: the worktree and setup script start only when the first message is sent ("Create without message" in the "Start from" menu for an empty one). iPhone, iPad and Android: the "+" opens "New workspace" with the same control. PRs from forks are refused with a message; older Macs don't show "Start from".

    • Patch Changes

  • #46 `ba9aac3` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Sturdier agents and connections. Stopping or ending a chat now also ends what its agent started (MCP servers, background shells), and agents end with Stellwerk even when it crashes. Very long agent output no longer slows the host down. Transcripts load gzipped (much less data over Tailscale), no change notice gets lost when a phone reads slowly, a message sent over a flaky connection is tried again and sent only once, and the apps reconnect right away after switching between Wi-Fi and cellular. The Usage tab shows Codex's limits too, Claude's come from /usage's structured report, and branch names come as structured output.
  • #63 `544aba6` Thanks @GarreltMock! - "Start from" → Branches lists the remote branches again instead of "No other branches".
  • #60 `9e2c71e` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk stays responsive with many workspaces running. Mac: the window no longer loses its connection to its own host after you look at a few workspaces with a terminal open. A terminal that's off screen stops streaming its output and picks up where it left off when shown again, and streams no longer use up the connections other requests need. Archiving takes seconds even for big workspaces: the folder is moved aside and deleted in the background, so archiving no longer fails with "git worktree failed (15)". If GitHub returns an error (such as a 502) for a merge that went through anyway, the merge counts as done. The apps wait long enough for Merge, Pull, Push and Archive. Turn checkpoints read only the files that changed. Pull request polling fetches each repository's target branch once instead of once per workspace, and runs a few workspaces at a time. If a git tool hangs, it no longer blocks one of the host's threads; at its timeout the tool and everything it started are stopped. When the host stops answering, the host log names the part that hangs.
  • #63 `544aba6` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the right panel's Changes shows the spinner while loading instead of an earlier "Couldn’t load changes", and tries again after 4 s when loading failed.
  • #43 `483d562` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: "Use the account with the most of its week left" now switches only when the active Claude account's limits run out (its current session or week), not as soon as another account has used 5 points less of its week. Then it asks the other accounts first (a one-word Haiku turn, all at once), so it picks by fresh numbers.
  • #52 `3fb5315` Thanks @GarreltMock! - A `stellwerk://pair` link opened from outside the app (camera, message, web page) now asks "Pair with …?" before pairing, on iPhone, iPad, Android and the Mac. Continuing a teammate's session asks first too, since their branch's setup script and agent hooks then run on your Mac.
  • #63 `544aba6` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Find in chat (⌘F) puts the cursor in its field reliably on the Mac, iPhone and iPad.
  • #49 `afc3b71` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac and Android look for new releases every hour instead of every six hours.
  • #63 `544aba6` Thanks @GarreltMock! - A screenshot or file pasted into the middle of a message on the Mac stays where it was in the sent message instead of moving to its start (the Mac's host says so in `/api/health`; older hosts keep it in front). Queued messages show their attachments under the text on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android.
  • #45 `bc2dc1d` Thanks @fabifink! - iPhone: after turning from landscape back to portrait the chat fits the screen again instead of running off both sides.
  • #63 `544aba6` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the right panel's + lists only tabs that aren't open yet and hides when all are open.
  • #46 `ba9aac3` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Plan mode: a plan now waits for you instead of going straight into implementing it. The chat ends its turn with the plan and a "Plan ready" card on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android: **Approve plan** sends it on out of plan mode, or write what to change.
  • #63 `544aba6` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: "Start from" → Pull requests shows the filtered list right away when Mine or Drafts is clicked, not only after typing.
  • #59 `d5dcd84` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Release review fixes:
  • **Queue:** a turn Claude rejects at the limits no longer uses up the queue. "Send now" can't send twice, and the sent prompt no longer disappears from the chat. Reset chat keeps queued prompts and cancels a planned "continue at reset".
  • **Security:**
  • Watch pull requests only sends review comments by the repo's owners, members and collaborators to the agent by itself.
  • Rotate shared token also ends the device tokens apps got for it.
  • A revoked device loses its open terminal and file streams too.
  • Wrong pairing codes lock out only their source.
  • Terminals can't set the clipboard (OSC 52) and open only http(s) links.
  • The copied pairing link stays out of clipboard managers.
  • **Mac:**
  • Right-panel terminals pause off screen, are let go with their workspace, and don't come back as new shells after a restart.
  • Switching workspaces no longer puts the cursor in a terminal.
  • Drafts close on switching Macs.
  • Return in setup's code field no longer skips the step.
  • Faster: the window redraws less, All files filters off the main thread, the chat minimap updates less while streaming, and the Usage tab asks at most once a minute.
  • **Host:**
  • Search indexing and PR watching cost less.
  • A failed Codex start no longer leaves a process behind.
  • Terminal output to slow clients is bounded.
  • **iPhone and Android:**
  • Retried sends no longer post twice to older Macs.
  • A pairing whose first check fails is kept.
  • Find and older pages no longer race the saved chat.
  • Network changes reconnect sooner, and the offline copy is written less often.
  • Android: dragging in the queue sends the right order, and "Resumes at" shows the date for another day like iPhone.
  • #57 `913c785` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Project icons come from the logo on the remote's default branch (`origin/HEAD`) instead of the project folder's checkout, which nobody updates since workspaces are worktrees. Stellwerk's own project showed the old Pocket logo because of that.
  • #63 `544aba6` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: the scripts panel's tabs (Setup, Run, Usage, terminals) wrap onto a second line when the right panel is too narrow.
  • #65 `56df2b8` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Mac: a terminal keeps its prompt and what was typed after switching workspaces and back.
  • #48 `7d9adca` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac, Usage tab: a Claude | Codex switch at the top, each agent in its own section. "Pick the account with the most of its week left" now sits under "Switch accounts when limits run out" and only says how it picks (on before means switching stays on). Each Claude account gets "Use when switching", so a switch skips the ones you leave out. The stop setting says it only stops once every account is out of room. Codex's limits show without a Codex chat (asked for free on opening the tab, on Refresh and every five minutes).
  • #52 `3fb5315` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Codex chats retry again when the model is at capacity, fast mode is offered for Opus 5 only (Claude Code ends it for Opus 4.8 on November 30), review comments added to a chat can no longer pose as your instructions, and dependencies are up to date.
  • #61 `588caba` Thanks @GarreltMock! - iOS: the "…" button in a workspace opens its menu again. The screen kept drawing itself over and over, which used a full CPU core and rebuilt the menu before it could open.

item.title: Stellwerk 0.24.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #42 `a3ea1f1` Thanks @fabifink! - Operator: off by default, with an on/off switch at the top of Settings → Operator on the Mac. Its model, to-do and summary settings show once it's on. While off, no app shows the Operator, no summaries are written and new to-dos stay in the list; turning it on or off shows or hides it on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android right away.

    • Patch Changes

  • #40 `5709ef2` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: Usage tab → "Use the account with the most of its week left". New turns run on the Claude account that has used the least of its weekly limit; Stellwerk switches once another is 5 points lower (asking it first with a one-word Haiku turn, so the number is fresh) and, when limits run out, to the account with the most left.
  • #37 `8ff9550` Thanks @fabifink! - Mac: links in replies are blue, like on the iPhone and Android. They had the text colour before.
  • #40 `5709ef2` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Stellwerk for Mac: when the window can't reach the Mac's own host, it says why (busy, not listening, connection broke off) instead of asking about Tailscale. The API server starts again by itself if it stops. The host log (Copy diagnostics) now notes when the window loses and regains its host, and when the host stalls because every thread waits for a tool, with the tools running then.
  • #38 `eace0e9` Thanks @fabifink! - A message sent to a new workspace before its folder is there waits in the chat's queue and goes out once it is, instead of failing with "The workspace's folder isn't there (yet)". Creating the folder fetches the default branch first, which can take a while (up to two minutes when GitHub is slow).
